news.headline: RBI MPC Meeting Begins Today (Oct 5-7) — 25bps Rate Hike Expected on Oct 7
news.what_happened: RBI's 3-day MPC meeting starts today. CPI inflation is tracking toward 6% and WPI stands at 9.92%. A 25bps repo rate hike from 5.25% to 5.50% is widely expected on October 7 — the first hike since February 2023.
news.why_it_matters: Rate-sensitive sectors face headwinds all week. Banks, NBFCs, real estate and auto loan demand all under pressure. Mid-week volatility expected around the announcement.

news.headline: US Soft Jobs Data Eases Fed Rate-Hike Fears — S&P 500 +0.73%, Nasdaq +1.19%
news.what_happened: Weaker-than-expected US nonfarm payrolls data on Friday Oct 2 caused markets to price out further Federal Reserve tightening. S&P 500 closed at 7,722.72 (+0.73%) and Nasdaq at 27,190.86 (+1.19%).
news.why_it_matters: Risk-on globally. GIFT Nifty indicates ~1% gap-up for NSE open today. IT sector benefits from Nasdaq valuation re-rating. FII sentiment may improve marginally.

news.headline: WTI Crude -1.17% to $90.04/bbl — Fuel & Input Cost Relief for Airlines, Tyres, Paints
news.what_happened: WTI crude fell $1.07 to $90.04 and Brent fell $0.87 to $101.38. Softer global demand sentiment weighed on oil prices despite some Strait of Hormuz supply concern on Brent.
news.why_it_matters: IndiGo saves ~Rs400 Cr/year per $1 crude drop — jet fuel is 40% of OPEX. Tyre makers see input cost relief as synthetic rubber/carbon black (60-70% of input cost) track crude. Paints sector benefits on petroleum-derived raw material cost.

news.headline: Nifty Extends Losing Streak to 8th Consecutive Week — FII Net Sold Rs9,484 Cr on Oct 1
news.what_happened: Nifty closed at 22,421.95 on Oct 2 (-0.88% on the day), marking the eighth consecutive weekly decline. FIIs were net sellers of Rs9,484 Cr on Oct 1, their 6th consecutive selling day with 5-day outflow totalling Rs38,660 Cr.
news.why_it_matters: Market technically weak. DIIs absorbed with Rs10,042 Cr buying (30-day streak) but the broader trend remains negative. A FII reversal is the key catalyst needed for a sustained recovery.

news.headline: US-China Trade Truce After Xi-Trump Summit — Tariff Cuts on $30B of Imports
news.what_happened: The US and China agreed to reduce tariffs on approximately $30 billion worth of bilateral imports following the Xi-Trump summit last week. Analysts describe the truce as fragile but markets reacted positively — Nikkei surged 2.53%.
news.why_it_matters: Improved global risk sentiment benefits EM flows. Metals and commodities may get a brief boost from improved China trade outlook. India gains indirectly through EM sentiment improvement.
